newsitem.title: USA: Chile buys Oriente crude oil for May delivery.
newsitem.headline: Chile buys Oriente crude oil for May delivery.

text.p: Chile's state-owned oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) bought 360,000 barrels of Ecuadoran Oriente crude oil in its latest purchase tender, trade sources said on Friday.
The crude will be delivered around May 20.
Ecuadoran trading house Tripetrol, a key Oriente broker, won the tender.
The sour crude was sold at an undisclosed discount to benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing.

ENAP customarily tenders for 960,000 barrels of crude every two to three weeks. Because only one cargo was purchased in this tender, a company official said another tender was likely to be issued next week.
One trader familiar with Chile's purchasing patterns suggested that ENAP hopes to secure a cheaper price for West African barrels next week for the same delivery date.

Elsewhere in the Southern Cone, Argentina's YPF has two 400,000 barrel cargoes of Canadon Seco and a 400,000 barrel cargo of Escalante on offer for April loading, trade sources said. ((--Patricia Garip-Bertuol NY Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620))
